long_biography.plain_text:
GFL Environmental, founded and still led by Patrick Dovigi, was designed as a one-stop provider in a fragmented waste-services market. It combined solid waste, recycling and environmental solutions, then expanded by acquiring independent regional operators and using them as bases for further consolidation.

Dovigi had moved into finance after playing junior hockey. Responsibility for cleaning up a troubled waste investment gave him direct experience of the industry's operational demands and revealed the scope for combining local businesses. He established GFL in 2007 and has led it since inception as founder, chairman, president and chief executive. The company retains a decentralised structure, with regional leaders holding operating responsibility in their markets.
